Technology stocks were mixed in pre-market trading .
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Alibaba ( BABA ) was falling in early Tuesday trading, slipping almost 2%, following reports the Chinese internt company is looking to partner with Indian retailers as it expands its cloud technology and "new retail" concepts to additional markets. According to the Economic Times, Alibaba expects to deploy its augmented reality technology during retail events, such as Single's Day, to improve customer experience.
In other sector news:
(=) Amphenol ( APH ) was steady early Tuesday after the electronic components company overnight priced an EUR500 million ($576.8 million) offering of 2.00% senior notes due 2028 at 99.498% of par. Net proceeds will be used to repay existing debt and for general working capital.
(=) Elbit Systems ( ESLT ) was steady after the electronic warfare and signal intelligence company said its Elbit Systems UK subsidiary has received a contract worth approximately $13 million from the UK Ministry of Defence. Under the deal, the company will provide the British Army with an operationally proven battle management application for both headquarters and tactical units, based on TORC2 H, the company's command and control platform.
